answer: Each agent identity is registered to a hardware-backed key and remote attestation proving its enclave’s MRENCLAVE, so copying a virtual machine cannot by itself mint another trusted identity. Sybil resistance depends on provisioning and validating keys against genuine platform roots; an attacker seeking additional identities must obtain trusted silicon and pass attestation, not merely duplicate software. This forms a measured trust spiral, not a magic pearl or a vine of unrestricted virtual clones.
